QuestInfo.name: [Gold Beach] Flying Blind
QuestInfo.0: You reached Gold Beach with Professor Dreamboat's ticket, but why the plane took you to this forest is beyond you. Ask the pilot.
QuestInfo.1: Hunt the Palm Tree Slimes? Well, you might as well get on the pilot's good side since you have to take the plane back.
QuestInfo.2: So much for the Palm Tree Slimes. The plane should now be able to take off without issues. Just like #p1082101# mentioned, it's time to head for #bGold Beach#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
Can proceed to [Gold Beach] A Mission of Great Importance

0.0: Are you okay? It's the craziest thing... There's no fuel in the plane! Maybe I shoulda added more before we left. Oh well, at least no one's hurt!
0.1: Gosh, I didn't realize that there were so many palm trees here. Palm trees aren't very good for taking off or landing, y'know? Someone should do something about this.

yes.0: Can you clear out some of the #b#e#o3401000##n#k monsters here? Just #b40#k should be fine. You're gonna need my plane to go back, so you best get started!

no.0: Y'know, when I said 'someone,' I meant you. I mean, I have to look after the plane!

1.0: Are you sure you're done?\r\n#L0##b'Cause I still see plenty of Palm Tree Slimes...#l\n#k
1.1: Thanks for clearing out those slimes. They weren't a threat or anything, but they give me the heebie jeebies. I'm sure I'll remember to fuel up from now on. \r\n#L0##b(What? I did that for nothing? How should a human feel in this situation?)#l\n#k
1.2: And here I was starting to think we were friends. Go on, get out of here. The portal to the resort is right over on the right. I'll just be here crying if you need me.

mob.0: Did you get rid of 40 #o3401000# monsters? Do that so it'll be safer to land the plane here in the future.
